questions.question: If 25 August 2006 was Friday, then what was the day of the week on 25 August 2018?
questions.solution:
Given: **25 August 2006** was Friday.

Now,

2006 to 2018 = 12 Years (9 Ordinary Years and 3 Leap Years).

And, In 12 Years = 3 Leap years and 9 Ordinary Years.

So, 3 Leap Years have 6 odd days,

And, 9 Ordinary Years have 9 odd days.

Total odd days = 6 + 9 = 15.

15 odd days → 15/7 = 2 weeks and 1 odd day.

then, 25 August 2018 will be Friday + 1 = Saturday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

No rose is an orchid.

All roses are lilies.

All lilies are lotuses.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some lilies are orchids.

II. Some lotuses are orchids.

III. All lilies are orchids.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusions I, II nor III follows.
Both conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66452867befdae18477043dc783ffa981d4b68e7efab1b35a507470b211f8668.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some lilies are orchids → Does not follow (As no rose is an orchid and all roses are lilies. So it is possible but not definite)

II. Some lotuses are orchids → Does not follow (As no rose is an orchid, all roses are lilies and all lilies are lotuses. So it is possible but not definite)

III. All lilies are orchids → Does not follow (As no rose is an orchid, all roses are lilies and all lilies are lotuses. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Neither conclusions I, II nor III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusions I, II nor III follows**"

questions.question:
